note.note:
Please provide:

- The full transcript (doctor-patient conversation) as text.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Notes on processing once provided:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source of factual information.
- I will use the DDx to enrich reasoning only if consistent with the transcript; if conflicts exist, I will include both statements and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will extract only clinically relevant information (presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history if available, physical findings, working diagnosis/impression, differentials from DDx if consistent, management plan, follow-up).
- I will not invent data (e.g., vitals, lab values) beyond what is in the transcript or DDx, and I will note any medications mentioned without dose/route/frequency as “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- Output will follow the exact structure:
  Subjective:
  - ...
  Objective:
  - ...
  Assessment & Plan:
  1. Issue/Problem/Request 1:
     - ...
  2. Issue/Problem/Request 2:
     - ...
  (additional issues as applicable)
  Quality checks:
  - Missing but clinically expected elements...
  - Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
  - Brief comment on transcript quality if needed

Once you share the transcript and DDx, I will generate the SOAP note accordingly.
